question: Select the most appropriate option to fill the blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'established'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's take a look at the keyword '**In April 1945'** which suggests that it is **talking about past action which is finished in past** thus, the tense will be used to express it, is simple past tense.
 
• Simple past tense: It represents an action which started in past, finishes in past, and has no relation to the future.
 
• **Structure:**
 
 
• Subject+ second form of the verb
 
 
• He went home yesterday.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** option 2.**
